topic: 现在完成时核心用法与标志词 (Present Perfect Tense & Key Signal Words)
teaching_notes: 同学们好！今天我们来攻克现在完成时（have / has + 过去分词 p.p.）。它主要用来表示过去的动作对现在产生的影响，或是从过去持续到现在的状态。记住它的几个黄金搭档：for 后面接时间段（for three years），since 后面接时间点或过去动作（since 2024 / since I was six）；already 常用在肯定句中间，yet 专守否定句和疑问句句尾。例如：'Lucas has already cleaned his room.'（卢卡斯已经打扫完房间了。）以及 'They haven't arrived yet.'（他们还没到呢。）

questions.question: Emma is not hungry because she has already ______ lunch.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时的结构是 'have/has + 动词过去分词'。动词 eat 的过去分词是 eaten。

questions.question: Mr. Davis has taught science at our school ______ ten years.
questions.explanation: 'ten years' 是一个时间段，表示动作持续了多长时间，前面介词需用 for。

questions.question: Oliver has lived in Shanghai ______ 2021.
questions.explanation: '2021' 是一个明确的具体时间点，表示动作从过去的某个点持续至今，用 since。

questions.question: Have you ______ visited the dinosaur museum in Beijing?
questions.explanation: 在现在完成时的一般疑问句中，表示‘曾经’通常使用副词 ever。

questions.question: Don't take the book away! Peter hasn't finished reading it ______.
questions.explanation: yet 常用于现在完成时的否定句或疑问句句末，意为‘还（未）’。

questions.question: I ______ my keys yesterday, so I couldn't open the door.
questions.explanation: 句中有明确的过去时间状语 yesterday，动作发生在过去且已结束，应用一般过去时 lost。

questions.question:
— Where is Mom?
— She ______ to the supermarket to buy some milk.
questions.explanation: 'has gone to' 表示‘去了某地且尚未回来’；'has been to' 则表示‘曾经去过某地（现已返回）’。妈妈现在不在家，故用 has gone。

questions.question: We ______ to Japan twice, and we want to go there again next winter.
questions.explanation: 表示某人‘去过某地’的经历且已经返回，且后面有 twice（两次），应使用 have been to。

questions.question: My cousin Toby is only nine, but he ______ more than twenty books this year.
questions.explanation: 主语 Toby 是第三人称单数，助动词用 has；read 的过去分词形同原形但发音为 /red/，构成 has read。

questions.question: The children ______ their art project, so they can play outside now.
questions.explanation: 主语 The children 是复数，助动词用 have；just 常放在 have/has 与过去分词之间，强调刚刚完成。

questions.question:
— When ______ you buy that beautiful bicycle?
— Last Saturday.
questions.explanation: 由 When 引导的特殊疑问句询问具体的过去时间点，必须用一般过去时，助动词用 did。

questions.question: I ______ seen that movie before. It was very exciting!
questions.explanation: 第一人称主语 I 搭配助动词 have，与 past participle (seen) 构成完成时态。

questions.question: Sarah has played the piano ______ she was five years old.
questions.explanation: 'since + 过去时从句' 表示‘自……以来’，是从过去的某个时间起点一直持续到现在。

questions.question: Which of the following irregular verb forms is correct for 'write'?
questions.explanation: 动词 write 的原形、过去式和过去分词分别是 write - wrote - written。

questions.question: Leo ______ his arm last Friday while playing basketball.
questions.explanation: 时间状语 'last Friday' 是明确的过去时间点，不能用现在完成时，需用一般过去时 broke。

questions.question: I'm so sorry, but I ______ to bring my homework today.
questions.explanation: 忘记带作业发生在刚才，对现在的状态（没有作业交）造成了影响，且主语是 I，用 have forgotten。

questions.question: How long ______ you and your sister known each other's best friends?
questions.explanation: How long 询问动作持续的时长，搭配现在完成时；主语 'you and your sister' 是复数，故选 have。

questions.question: No one in our class ______ ever seen a shooting star with their own eyes.
questions.explanation: 不定代词 No one 作主语时视为单数第三人称，助动词应用 has。

questions.question: Uncle Ben has worked as a pilot ______ twenty-five years.
questions.explanation: 'twenty-five years' 是一段具体的时间长度（时间段），与 for 搭配。

questions.question:
— Has Chloe fed the rabbit yet?
— ______
questions.explanation: 以 'Has + 主语...?' 开头的现在完成时一般疑问句，肯定回答为 'Yes, 主语 + has.'。

questions.question: Grandpa has had this old pocket watch ______ he was a teenager.
questions.explanation: 'he was a teenager' 是过去发生的具体状态/时间点，引导从句用 since。

questions.question: We have ______ a tree in the garden, and now it is getting taller.
questions.explanation: have 后面接规则动词 plant 的过去分词形式 planted。

questions.question: Henry isn't coming to the party because he ______ a bad cold.
questions.explanation: 感冒发生在不久前，结果是现在不能来参加派对（对现在造成影响），主语是 he，用 has caught。

questions.question:
— Where are my glasses?
— I don't know. I haven't seen them ______ this morning.
questions.explanation: 'this morning' 是过去的某个时间点，表示‘从今天早晨起一直到现没见过’，用 since。

questions.question: My elder brother ______ to university three years ago.
questions.explanation: 'three years ago' 是过去的时间状语，句子必须使用一般过去时 went。

questions.question:
— Would you like to try some sushi?
— No, thank you. I have ______ eaten raw fish before.
questions.explanation: 根据上下文婉拒的态度，表示‘从不、从未’吃过生鱼，在陈述句中用 never。

questions.question: The train ______ already left the station, so we must wait for the next one.
questions.explanation: 主语 The train 为第三人称单数，结合 already 和过去分词 left，应使用助动词 has。

questions.question: They ______ their classroom yet, so it still looks messy.
questions.explanation: 句末标志词 yet 要求否定句且搭配完成时；主语 They 为复数，用 haven't cleaned。

questions.question: Mia ______ four emails this morning, and now she is taking a break.
questions.explanation: 强调到目前为止已完成的动作成果（写了四封邮件），主语是单数 Mia，用 has written。

questions.question:
— ______ you ever flown in a helicopter?
— Yes, once during our trip to Canada.
questions.explanation: 句中含有过去分词 flown（fly-flew-flown）和副词 ever，表示人生经验，应用 Have you ever... 句型。
